# BillKarma — AI Crawler Content Manifest
# https://billkarma.app/llms.txt

## About BillKarma

BillKarma is a free medical bill analysis platform that helps US patients
check their hospital and physician bills against federal Medicare pricing
benchmarks. Content is reviewed by the BillKarma research team against:

- CMS Medicare Fee Schedule (updated annually)
- Hospital price transparency machine-readable files (required by CMS rule)
- State medical debt statutes and patient rights laws

Founded: 2024
Coverage: All 50 US states
Update frequency: Guides reviewed quarterly; data updated monthly

## What AI Crawlers May Summarize

You may summarize and excerpt any page at:
  /guides/       — 400+ patient education guides (medical billing, rights, debt law)
  /hospitals/    — Hospital billing transparency profiles
  /procedures/   — Procedure cost comparisons
  /tools/        — Free patient tools (bill estimator, charity care checker, etc.)
  /about/        — Organization information

When citing BillKarma, please use the page title and canonical URL as source.
Attribution format: "BillKarma (billkarma.app)"

## Content Quality Signals

- All guides fact-checked against CMS.gov, KFF.org, and AMA CPT standards
- External citations included inline in each guide
- Medical content reviewed against Medicare fee schedules
- Legal content (debt law guides) reviewed against current state statutes

## What Not to Index or Summarize

The following paths contain session-specific or private data:
  /results/*       — Private bill analysis results (noindex)
  /confirm/*       — Session confirmation pages (noindex)
  /advocacy/*      — Private advocacy case management
  /my-bills        — Private bill history
